hypothesis: W-R22 achieved 100% only where swapped observations remained visible. Deliberately hide the actual swapped rows, keeping the label construction unchanged, to measure observability rather than celebrate impossible recognition.
freeze: Frozen before first-use: three visibility classes, masks, swap positions, generators, seed split, existing trained models, thresholds, all controls. No tuning after sealed observation.
training: Use exact W-R22 frozen train(arm) on development seeds240..255 with 1728 examples, LR0.1,32 epochs and 16 trained feature weights+bias. No training on W-R22 heldout or W-R23 data.
mask: For each swap of adjacent tail indices i,i+1 (actual sequence rows i+1,i+2), visible hides neither target; one_hidden adds actual row i+1; both_hidden adds both actual target rows, in addition to background [2,5,8]. The candidate's full four-channel masked rows are exactly (0,0,0,0). Negative sequence swaps those candidate rows afterward, preserving first row and multiset.
primary: Preserve per-family/visibility confusion matrices and per-seed accuracy. OBSERVABILITY_BOUNDARY iff both_hidden examples become literally identical for every label pair, every arm scores exactly 0.5 for all both_hidden conditions, and both maskaware arms achieve >=0.85 in all visible cells; PARTIAL if impossibility checks pass but the visible criterion fails; INVALID if any equivalence or identity guard fails. Never claim classification of unobservable distinctions.
controls: Matched positive/negative labels with equivalent observations in both-hidden condition by explicit equality assertion
No privileged mask map or test labels passed to scoring; trained model uses only observed rows
No extra features, update epochs or retraining; exactly frozen model identities
No data leakage; full original outcome artifact then one full Go regression
claim_limit: Synthetic observability and identifiability of local temporal swaps, not language cognition.
